title: compile.ts: mask HasClipDepth never emitted for imported binary FLAs
description:
File: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, lines 1595-1617 (maskClipDepths computation) and lines 1317-1325 (isMaskedLi pre-pass).

Bug: When a FLA is imported from a binary Flash 8 file (e.g. Magnet.fla), masked layers appear at LOWER model indices (li=0,1,2) than their owning mask layer (li=3). This is caused by flash8-import.ts convertTimeline() reversing the binary layer order: in the binary, the mask is stored before its masked children; after reversal the mask ends up at a higher model li.

compile.ts assumes mask layer is at li=X and masked layers are at li=X+1, X+2, etc. (mask has LOWER li than masked). The two loops that assume this ordering:

1. isMaskedLi pre-pass (lines 1317-1325): the inner loop scans mli = li+1, li+2, ... and never finds masked layers when they are at li < mask_li. So isMaskedLi is empty and masked layers are processed as normal layers.

2. maskClipDepths computation (lines 1597-1617): same forward-only scan from li+1; maxDepth stays 0 for the mask because masked layers are at li=0,1,2 (before mask at li=3). maskClipDepths is never set for that mask, so clipDepth === undefined and the mask shape is placed WITHOUT HasClipDepth --- it renders as a normal visible shape, not as a mask.

Evidence: magnet-inspect.test.ts verifies Ball/Walls/Magnets have type=masked and maskIdx > ballIdx. Debug confirms: Ball(li=0), Walls(li=1), Magnets(li=2), Layer5/mask(li=3). compile.ts scan from li+1=4 finds Layer3/Layer7 (normal), not masked layers.

Fix options:
(A) Fix flash8-import.ts convertTimeline() to re-sort mask groups after reversal so mask is always at lower li than its masked children (matches compile.ts expectation).
(B) Fix compile.ts maskClipDepths and isMaskedLi to scan BOTH forward and backward from each mask layer.

Option A is simpler and the right fix. After the reversedBinary.map() in convertTimeline(), do a second pass that reorders: for each mask at position P, move the mask to just before its consecutive run of masked children. The existing depth pre-pass (isMaskedLi) becomes correct after that fix too.
